import json
from pathlib import Path
from api.admin_scheduler_resync import _execute_edarsahub_query

def test_check_cf_orphans():
    rows = _execute_edarsahub_query("""SELECT CONVERT(varchar(10),fecha_operacion,23) AS fecha_operacion, ventas_total, propinas_total, tickets_total, pax_total, activo, sync_run_id FROM dbo.Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2 WHERE unidad_negocio_id='CIENFUEGOS' AND fecha_operacion IN ('2026-03-12','2026-03-22') AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1 ORDER BY fecha_operacion""")
    Path('tests/check_cf_orphans_current.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,default=str),encoding='utf-8')
    assert True
